card.label: Attachment translated by Day One: {name}
card.nothingForYou: Nothing specific for your team in this attachment.
card.byService: What it changes, team by team

picker.drop: or drop it here: CSV or Excel (.xlsx), 5 MB max
picker.dropActive: Drop the file: Day One reads and translates it
picker.reading: Day One is reading the file…
picker.translating: Day One is translating the contract…

errors.tooBig: File too large ({size}): 5 MB max. Export only the period you need.
errors.empty: The file is empty: no rows to read.
errors.unreadable: Day One can’t read “{name}”. Try again with a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) export.
errors.pdf: PDFs can’t be read yet: export the statement as CSV or Excel (.xlsx), then attach it.
errors.word: Word documents can’t be read yet: attach the table as CSV or Excel (.xlsx), or paste the text into the note.
errors.xls: .{ext} format: save the file as Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, then attach it.
errors.unsupported: .{ext} files aren’t supported: attach a CSV or an Excel (.xlsx) file.
errors.encrypted: Password-protected Excel file: save an unprotected copy, then attach it.
errors.noContract: No contract for {artist} in Day One: nothing to translate.

points.gapSource: The gap comes mostly from {dsp}: {amount} ({pct}) against Day One’s estimate.
points.gapOk: In line with Day One’s estimate ({pct}): nothing to claim.
points.gapOver: Received above Day One’s estimate ({pct}): check it, an adjustment may follow.
points.scale: The statement is {ratio} of Day One’s estimate: it probably covers only part of the catalogue or of the rights. Gap not interpreted.
points.currency: Statement in {currency}: no comparison with the expected amount without the month’s ECB rate.
points.currencyUnknown: No currency in the file: amounts read as euros.
points.multiArtist: Statement for {count} artists: no comparison with a single artist’s expected amount.
points.rows: {rows, plural, one {# row read} other {# rows read}} over {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
points.commission: Received {pct} of Day One’s estimate across every platform: that looks like a distributor’s commission. Check before claiming.

roles.financeClaim: Claim {amount} from {dsp}: the largest shortfall in the statement.
roles.financeClaimBy: Claim {amount} from {dsp} before {date}, when the contract’s audit window closes.
roles.financeShare: {artist}’s share at the contract rate ({rate}): {amount}, to pay with this statement.
roles.financeShareRecouping: {artist}’s share at the contract rate ({rate}): {amount}, to set against the advance ({remaining} still to recoup).
roles.financeCheck: Match the {total} against the {format} payment: nothing to claim.
roles.financeNoExpected: Match the {total} against the {format} payment: no Day One estimate to compare with.
roles.da: “{title}” brings in {pct} of the statement’s revenue, ahead of {next}.
roles.daSingle: “{title}” brings in {pct} of the statement’s revenue.
roles.daGap: “{title}” brings in {pct} of revenue; the gap comes mostly from {dsp}.
roles.daGapOnly: The gap comes mostly from {dsp}: nothing changes on the tracks’ side.
roles.juridiqueAudit: The contract’s audit window is open until {date}: grounds to dispute the missing {amount}.
roles.juridiqueWithheld: Withholding tax of {amount}: check that the contract provides for it.
roles.directionGap: {pct} vs expected over {period} ({amount}): your call, claim or let it go.
roles.directionClaim: Total at {pct} vs expected, but {dsp} underpaid {amount}: Finance is claiming it.
roles.directionOver: {pct} above expected over {period}: check before counting on it.
roles.directionOk: {total} over {period}, in line with expected ({pct}): nothing to decide.
roles.presidenceGap: In one line: {total} received over {period}, {pct} vs expected.

sheet.headline: Spreadsheet “{name}”: {total} of {column} across {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
sheet.headlinePlain: Spreadsheet “{name}”: {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}, {cols, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}

points.noNumeric: No number columns: a text table, to read as is.
points.totalRow: The file’s “{label}” row is left out of the sums.
points.totalMismatch: The file’s “{label}” row says {stated} for {column}, the rows add up to {computed}: a {diff} gap.

roles.finance: Check the {column} total: {total}, the sum of {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}.
roles.financeMismatch: Fix the file: the “{label}” row is {diff} off the sum of the rows ({column}).
roles.da: {label} accounts for {pct} of {column}: the largest row in the table.
roles.direction: {total} of {column} across {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}; {label} on top ({pct}).
roles.directionTotal: {total} of {column} across {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}.
roles.directionPlain: A {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} table with no number column: to read as is.
roles.presidence: In one line: {total} of {column}, {label} on top.

points.rateLicence: On every euro the tracks bring in, {artist} gets {rate} (royalties); {counterparty} keeps the rest.
points.rateDistribution: {artist} keeps {rate} of what the tracks bring in; {counterparty} takes {fee} for distribution.
points.rateEdition: On publishing income, {artist} keeps {rate}; the publisher {counterparty} keeps {fee}.
points.noAdvance: No advance: royalties are paid from the first euro, nothing to pay back first.
points.recouped: The {advance} advance is fully paid back by royalties: they are now paid out.
points.recouping: {advance} advance: {recouped} already paid back by royalties ({pct}). Until the remaining {remaining} is, {artist} gets nothing more.
points.nextEnd: Next deadline: the contract ends on {date}.
points.riskRecoup: Watch out: {remaining} of advance still to recoup before the contract ends ({date}).

roles.juridiqueOption: Exercise the option or not before {date}: prepare the label’s position.
roles.juridiqueExpiry: Send notice or not before {date} (the contract ends on {end}).
roles.juridiqueAudit: Audit window open until {date}: request the statements in time.
roles.juridiqueClause: Clause to remove at the next amendment: {what}.
roles.juridiqueNone: Nothing to prepare before the contract ends on {end}.
roles.financeRecouping: {remaining} of advance still to recoup: {artist}’s royalties go against it, nothing to pay until then.
roles.financeRecouped: Advance recouped: pay {artist} their {rate} with every statement.
roles.financeNoAdvance: No advance: pay {artist} their {rate} with every statement.
roles.daNext: Before starting a project with {artist}: {what} on {date}.
roles.daEnd: Before starting a project with {artist}: the contract runs until {end}.
roles.directionExposed: {remaining} still exposed on {artist} ({pct} recouped); next deadline on {date}.
roles.directionClear: Nothing exposed on {artist}; next deadline on {date}.
roles.presidence: In one line: {type} deal with {counterparty} until {end}, advance {status}.
